title: OIDC step-up for Keys and secrets
summary: Staff who sign in with APES Cloudron can confirm sensitive actions again through Cloudron sign-in, including saving secrets in Admin settings. Local password and passkey confirmation for public accounts is unchanged.
changes: When a Cloudron directory staff member needs to re-confirm before a sensitive change, MyAPES Account sends them through Staff Login again (Cloudron asks them to sign in) and then returns them to what they were doing.
Admin → Settings → Keys and secrets and other step-up gated actions work for Cloudron staff after that re-confirmation.
People with a local password or passkey still confirm the same way as before.
version_rationale: Patch: restores step-up confirmation for Cloudron directory identities without changing local confirm behaviour or adding migrations.
validation: PHPUnit suites for OIDC step-up, local step-up, Keys and secrets, force re-authentication and Cloudron OIDC redirects passed locally, with Pint on changed files.
composer pre-pr-verify and CI checks on the milestone pull request.
rollback: Deploy v0.64.0 with deploy-cloudron.yml. Cloudron staff lose step-up again for Keys and secrets until a later fix is deployed; local password confirm is unchanged.
provenance: Milestone v0.64.1 Beta: OIDC step-up for Keys and secrets, epic #824 with issue #823; pull request #825.
